The television series titled "José Rizal" premiered on October 20, 2014, on GMA Network's Telebabad lineup, replacing "My Destiny." It concluded on November 14, 2014, with a total of 20 episodes, and was replaced by "More Than Words" in its timeslot. In March 2016, the series was released on DVD by GMA Records Home Video. The series is currently streaming on YouTube.

Upon his return home, he uses the knowledge and skills he acquired abroad to improve the lives of his family and countrymen.
